text:
sally_cust: hey team — customer (FinLedger) just flagged their SIG/CAIQ has a due date in 48h and they want: data retention policy export, audit log samples for last 90d, and proof of KMS key rotation (HSM attestation). also they hit intermittent 401s when trying to download the export earlier, so they're worried about failed exports. can we confirm what we can provide and an ETA? :alarm_clock:

elaine: on it. can we get the exact questionnaire fields they marked as "required"? sometimes they only need retention window + sample logs, not the full export.

sally_cust: they marked: "Data retention period (logs, artifacts)", "Export procedure and sample audit logs (90 days)", "KMS key rotation proof / HSM attestation", and "Evidence of successful export for customer data". they want a download link or signed statement. due 48h from now.

ajay: putting infosec on standby. for KMS/HSM we can provide the attestation doc we have and a key rotation timeline. note: we do not give raw key material. we can provide signed cert + rotation metadata (timestamps, key IDs, rotation events).

tom: re: 401s — pulled logs for the export job: ```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z export-service: start job id=exp-9345 customer=finledger
2026-03-15T14:02:13Z auth: token validation failed status=401 sub=requester-id=acct-88
2026-03-15T14:02:13Z export-service: retrying auth, attempt=2
2026-03-15T14:02:15Z auth: token refreshed via oauth proxy status=200
2026-03-15T14:02:16Z export-service: job resumed
```
looks like transient token expiry at the time of their attempt. we should include these lines as part of the export repro notes.

samir: i can draft a concise export playbook for the questionnaire: steps to request export, expected files, hash verification commands, and troubleshooting steps (incl. token refresh flow). will also include the exact API endpoints and example curl.

samir: sample curl to request export (include in playbook):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"acct-88","range":{"from":"2025-12-15","to":"2026-03-15"}}'
```
note: remind customers to use the service account token and not a short-lived UI token.

elaine: good call. ajay, can you confirm the KMS attestation file path and whether legal needs to redline the wording?

ajay: attestation PDF v2 is in /secure/attestations/redwood_hsm_attestation_2025_v2.pdf. i'll attach a redacted version (strip internal account ids) and sign off. legal has a standard blurb we usually append; copying that will speed approval.

triage-bot: created support ticket #CS-14287 and linked to customer questionnaire. SLA: 48h due-date flagged.

elaine: plan: samir will assemble the export playbook + token repro notes (ETA 3h). tom will attach the 401 log snippet (done). ajay will produce attestation + rotation timeline (ETA 6h). i'll compile into a single response, include the sample logs and a short statement about what we cannot provide (no raw keys, no raw audit traces with internal IDs).

sally_cust: appreciate it. any chance we can give the customer a one-page summary they can attach to the SIG and a link to the full ZIP? they'd prefer one summary doc + links.

samir: yes i will include a one-page summary with checklist items and direct links to the artifacts (signed attestation, playbook, export hash file).

elaine: thumbs up. will update customer in thread once compiled. :white_check_mark:

sally_cust: great — please ping if anything blocks legal/infosec sign-off. thanks everyone! :pray:
